paragraphs: Rabbi Yirmeyah (a Tanna of a baraita).

He is mentioned in Megillah 18a and Menachot 32b, where it was taught: Rabbi Yirmeyah says in the name of our Rabbi; and in Horayot 8b, where it was taught: Rabbi Yirmeyah used to say, and the source is from the Tosefta, chapter 1 of Shevuot.
He is also mentioned in the Mekhilta, Bo, chapter 2, and Beshalach, chapter 1, section 7; and in Sifra, Acharei, at locator 143.

notes.text: The Mekhilta locator reads chapter 1, section 7, rather than chapters 1–7. Our teacher is left without a new personal identification.
